metricDefinitions.label: Final rating
metricDefinitions.definition: Minimum of the adjusted rating after deleting each match in turn. Units are adjusted runs per 100 balls, with 60 virtual balls of shrinkage.

metricDefinitions.label: Own-baseline lift
metricDefinitions.definition: Adjusted runs per 100 qualifying balls relative to that player’s earlier ordinary adjusted rate. This is a separate measure.

metricDefinitions.label: Bootstrap Q25
metricDefinitions.definition: 25th percentile of 20,000 whole-match resamples. The original expected values and eligibility stay fixed.

metricDefinitions.label: Sensitivity rating
metricDefinitions.definition: Minimum over match deletions of 100 times remaining adjusted value divided by remaining balls plus the selected shrinkage. At 60 added balls this reproduces the official final rating. Eligibility and contributions stay fixed. Other strengths are exploratory diagnostics, not a new submission order.

metricDefinitions.label: Match contribution
metricDefinitions.definition: Adjusted runs contributed in one observed match. Values include zero-exposure extras-only bowling records; only positive-exposure records count as matches. Records are ordered by supplied match ID, not by date.

evidenceFlow.title: Reproduce analytics inputs
evidenceFlow.detail: Run python supeRR-vercel/prepare-analytics.py. Select the official ten in each role from the existing reviewed shortlist, retain all their player-match aggregates, and assert ball totals, positive-exposure match counts, and every 60-ball deletion rating against the reviewed shortlist. No delivery-level data is added.

methods.code: Source aggregates are prepared by supeRR-vercel/prepare-analytics.py. Interactive calculations are in src/content/dashboard/pressure-analytics.mjs. Preserve frozen eligibility and the official 60-ball ranking; a different shrinkage is a sensitivity scenario. Per-match bars show supplied adjusted value, ordered by match ID; they are not a chronological time series.

rows.label: Finishing depth
rows.title: Compare the market with a Hetmyer return
rows.decision: Ferreira is the internal option. If Hetmyer registers, use his RR role experience and price to benchmark alternatives for the overseas finishing slot. Keep Ferreira as cover if the pool offers no clear upgrade.
rows.status: RR released Hetmyer and retained Ferreira.

rows.label: Death bowling
rows.title: Keep Archer as the lead death bowler
rows.decision: Archer bowled 102 death balls for RR in the screened 2026 matches. Shami adds new-ball cover. Check Ferguson’s availability if RR wants a reserve quick. His overall rating was positive, while his IPL pressure sample was small and his net adjusted contribution in it was negative.
rows.status: Punjab Kings released Ferguson. Registration and availability remain unverified.

rows.label: Curran’s role
rows.title: Assess seam and batting cover separately
rows.decision: Curran’s trade takes away lower-order batting and left-arm seam in one roster spot. Assess those roles separately before committing to an all-rounder. Siddharth provides Indian left-arm spin for the powerplay, so an overseas spin bid would need to fill a different role.
rows.status: RR received Shami and Siddharth in the trade with Lucknow.
